colors.name: Primary Red
colors.role: The core brand red. Used for logos, CTAs, links, breaking indicators and active states.

colors.name: Secondary Yellow
colors.role: The highlight yellow for feature accents, highlights, subscription promos, paywall gates, subscription UI and premium content indicators.

colors.name: Ink Gray
colors.role: The ink gray scale for text, borders, surfaces and backgrounds.

clearSpace.note: Minimum clear space around a logo, as a share of the logo's height (brand hub: about 8 px on a 32 px logo). Confirm with the brand owner: the hub diagram draws it as one full logo height.

logos.name: Wordmark, red
logos.usage: Primary. On pure white and light backgrounds (Ink and Red steps 50 to 300), or on pure black and dark (950) backgrounds.

logos.name: Wordmark, white
logos.usage: Any other background with enough contrast, such as mid greys and reds.

logos.name: Wordmark, black
logos.usage: Single colour version for print, embossing or single-ink applications.

logos.name: Logomark, square
logos.usage: Favicon, app icon or social media profile picture.

logos.name: Logomark, round
logos.usage: Round avatars, for example social media profile pictures.

logos.name: Logomark, rounded square
logos.usage: App icons with softly rounded corners.
